title: The Blue Hour of Anderlecht
author: Lena Blackwood
blurb: Bram Brightwater, a piano tuner who hears the house's history in its radiators, moves through the days like a tenant, not an owner. But when a childhood home goes up for auction, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must return to the place where the story went wrong, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
